items.text: SpaceX Set to Open Higher on IPO Debut ----------------------------------------- Early shadow market trading indicates the SpaceX (NASDAQ:SPCX ) stock price could surge at least 35% after the market opens today, with retail investors alone submitting more than $100 billion in orders at the Thursday deadline, as final indications imply strong appetite for the company. * All 555,555,555 shares sold at $135 apiece: The WSJ reports BlackRock (NYSE:BLK ) put in an order to buy at least $5 billion worth of stock, with a separate family office alone requesting $1 billion. items.title: Item 2
items.text: Nvidia Opens Vera CPU Orders in China ---------------------------------------- Reuters reports Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA ) has informed Chinese clients of pending availability of Vera CPUs, with AI processor orders to be available as soon as August. * The Chinese market once accounted for over 20% of Nvidia’s data center revenue: The move would aim to kickstart China sales and provide an alternative from the stalling progress on the powerful H200 chip, with reported demand for the Vera processors according to domestic sources. * “Their local ecosystem of chip companies are doing quite well, because we’ve evacuated that market”: Speaking in late May, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang explained how China had large demand, but tight U.S. chip export restrictions meant the Stock Advisor Foundational Stock had largely conceded it. items.title: Item 3
items.text:
ADBE, LEN, and RH Earnings Disappoint ---------------------------------------- * Adobe (NASDAQ:ADBE ) fell around 5% ahead of the market open after the sudden departure of its CFO, Dan Durn, overshadowed a strong quarterly earnings beat . In the short term, the Team Rule Breakers recommendation expects revenue pressure as it focuses on a "freemium" model. * RH (NYSE:RH ) dropped about 1% in pre-market trading following a mixed bag of results . Also recommended by Team Rule Breakers, revenue for the quarter fell by 1.7% versus the same period last year, although management raised the full-year outlook based on opening new galleries. * Lennar (NYSE:LEN ) moved over 2% lower before the opening bell, pointing to “elevated mortgage rates and cautious consumer sentiment” in the quarterly earnings report as a factor in the 31% drop in earnings per share . Review why RH is in the penalty box DividerA message from The Motley Fool

A Calmer Way to Invest in the AI Boom

It’s easy to feel overwhelmed by the speed of the AI conversation — new tools, new breakthroughs, and new stock moves almost daily.

But long-term investing doesn’t require chasing the noise.

Our team focused on something different: smaller, less-hyped AI companies that are still early in their journey, often far cheaper than the mega-caps that dominate the news. Companies building quietly, consistently, and with real-world demand — even in a choppy market.

If you’re looking for a thoughtful way to participate in AI’s long-term growth, this could be a great place to start.

items.text: Rocket Lab Pops on Nasdaq 100 Promotion ------------------------------------------ The quarterly Nasdaq 100 rebalance sees Rocket Lab (NASDAQ:RKLB ) promoted alongside four others, with Zscaler (NASDAQ:ZS ) a notable removal. All changes take effect prior to the market open on Monday June

items.title: Item 22
items.text: * Rocket Lab pops around 6% in pre-market trading: The news carried the promoted stocks higher overnight, with the Stock Advisor rec by Team Hidden Gems now up an impressive 122% since the July 2025 selection. * Rotation shows current market winners and losers: The rebalance shows the investor pivot towards AI infrastructure and cloud computing, replacing more mature consumer-facing telecoms and older software firms. items.title: Item 5
items.text: Today’s Take: Bright Spots in a Bad Quarter ********************************************** Yasser El-Shimy A stock can plummet after earnings but actually end up boosting my conviction in the company. How? Management deliberately sacrifices short-term profitability to invest in growing new users, customer value and satisfaction, and IP. — YASSER EL-SHIMY • TEAM RULE BREAKERS Here’s a sneak preview, but head to the article to reveal the most important thing a company can tell you in a down quarter that makes you want to hold on anyway, or to submit questions to any of the featured analysts today! See more in Today’s Take Divider ************

items.title: Item 6
items.text: Your Take ************ WEDNESDAY'S TOP RESPONSE We asked: Which, if any, positions have you sold all or some of from your portfolio in the last month, and why? M Member Mojoat64 said “I reduced positions in Nvidia, Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL ), Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE ), and Marvell (NASDAQ:MRVL )] in anticipation of a market downturn, but mostly to free up capital for some of the upcoming IPOs. I will not jump in on day one, but I do want a strong cash position when things start to look interesting enough to buy.” See more great answers from our Foolish community TODAY'S QUESTION How are you playing the space economy theme, if at all?
